authority: T0 candidate certificate and horizon-origin proof programme; not a TECT action, claim, tier change, physical model, or cosmology
statement: The real-scalar PA-M2 candidate has an exact finite-torus inhomogeneous global-minimizer window below the identical zero reference, isolated full-rank CI8 nodes, concentration onto those nodes at onset, a kernel-restricted leading single-Q stripe morphology inequality, and a tree-level z=1 inertial cone. Stable and critical Gaussian modes have zero exponential rate; unstable quadratic modes are only linear instabilities. Separately, the fixed-background local double-null toy equation proves that a scalar trace on one generic open null sheet is insufficient starting data, while compatible traces on two intersecting sheets reconstruct the toy bulk. The 1+1 toy and three-dimensional PA-M2 have no proved composition map. No causal emergence, event-horizon origin, gravitational reconstruction, nonlinear chaos, or cyclic cosmology is thereby established.
candidate_verdict: ADVANCE AS A PRE-A DUAL-LANE BENCHMARK; MAKE HORIZON-ORIGIN RECONSTRUCTION THE PRIMARY NEXT GATE; KEEP CYCLICITY OPTIONAL AND DOWNSTREAM
